channel.title: About I4C 2026 :: IEEE IES INDUSTRIAL INNOVATION CONCLAVE(I4C)-2026
channel.description: IEEE IES Industrial Innovation Conclave 2026 Advancing Electrification · Automation · AI · Renewable Energy · Smart Mobility IEEE IES Industrial Innovation Conclave 2026 Advancing Electrification · Automation · AI · Renewable Energy · Smart Mobility IEEE IES Industrial Innovation Conclave 2026 Advancing Electrification · Automation · AI · Renewable Energy · Smart Mobility IEEE IES Industrial Innovation Conclave 2026 Advancing Electrification · Automation · AI · Renewable Energy · Smart Mobility About I4C 2026 IEEE IES Industrial Innovation Conclave 2026 The IEEE IES Industrial Innovation Conclave (I4C) 2026 is a two-day forum bringing together industry leaders, researchers, academicians, technology experts, innovators, and students to explore emerging technologies and foster meaningful collaboration. The conclave focuses on technologies shaping the future of industry, including Electrification, Industrial Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energy, Smart Mobility, Advanced Manufacturing, and Industrial IoT. I4C 2026 provides a platform for participants to exchange knowledge, discover emerging trends, showcase innovative solutions, connect with experts, and explore opportunities for research, careers, innovation, and industry collaboration. Event at a Glance 22–23 September 2026 Event Dates Two days of talks, workshops, industry interaction, technology exploration and networking. Hyderabad Venue Engineering Staff College of India (ESCI), Gachibowli, Hyderabad. Talks · Workshops · Expo Format Expert sessions, hands-on learning, panel discussions, networking and technology exhibition. What to Expect Expert Talks & Keynotes Insights from experts across emerging industrial technologies and engineering domains. Industry Talks Perspectives on real-world industrial applications, technologies and challenges. Hands-on Workshops Practical exposure to contemporary engineering technologies and workflows. Industry–Academia Interaction Opportunities to connect academic knowledge with industrial practice and applications. Technology Exhibition & Industry Expo Explore innovative technologies, demonstrations and solutions from the industrial ecosystem. Panel Discussions Exchange perspectives on emerging technologies and the future of industrial engineering. Networking & Speed Mentoring Meet professionals and explore opportunities across careers, research and collaboration. Knowledge Exchange Share ideas and build meaningful connections across disciplines and sectors. Technology & Innovation Focus The conclave explores emerging technologies and industrial applications across several important domains.
